# hubspot_crm_user_profile (Resource)

Manages selected CRM user profile properties for one HubSpot account membership without managing that membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_crm_user_profile" "operator" {
  account_membership_id = hubspot_account_membership.operator.id
  job_title             = "Release Engineer"
  availability_status   = "available"
  time_zone             = "Australia/Melbourne"
  working_hours = [
    {
      days         = "MONDAY_TO_FRIDAY"
      start_minute = 540
      end_minute   = 1020
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_membership_id` (String) Settings user `id` joined through `hs_internal_user_id`. Changes replace this management relationship.

### Optional

- `availability_status` (String) Managed CRM availability status: `available` or `away`. `null` leaves it unmanaged.
- `job_title` (String) Managed CRM user job title. `null` leaves `hs_job_title` unmanaged; an empty string clears it.
- `time_zone` (String) Managed `hs_standard_time_zone` identifier. `null` leaves it unmanaged.
- `working_hours` (Attributes Set) Managed non-overlapping working-hours intervals. `null` leaves `hs_working_hours` unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--working_hours))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical account-specific CRM user `id` used for state and import.

<a id="nestedatt--working_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `working_hours`

Required:

- `days` (String) Documented day or grouped-day value.
- `end_minute` (Number) Exclusive interval end minute, from `0` through `1440` and later than `start_minute`.
- `start_minute` (Number) Inclusive minute offset from midnight, from `0` through `1440`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_crm_user_profile.operator 'membership:123456789'
```
